'''''Ginger 3''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] that was part of [[Ginger group]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It fought at the [[Recapture of Outpost D-34|Second Battle of Javin]] where they attacked the [[Frigate/Legends|Frigate]] ''[[Fogger]]'' with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]]. They were unsuccessful and were destroyed instead.
